QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] Parwen's Pass
QuestInfo.0: #p2111006# is the chatty ghost at the basement lab of #m261000000#. Apparently, he knows a secret passage in #m261000000# that no one is aware of... I better go talk to #b#p2111006##k.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2111006# said that a long time ago, when he was an alchemist at #m261000000#, he had a #bpass#k that granted him access to the secret passage connecting the bases of the Zenumists and Alcadnos. A Secret Passage? How interesting! It seems like #rSaities#k may have taken the #t4031745#. I'll have to find it if I want to enter the Secret Passage.
 

#i4031745# #t4031745# #b#c4031745##k/1 

The #bentrance of the Secret Passage#k is the locked door accessed from either #r#m261010000##k or #r#m261020200##k.
QuestInfo.2: I brought #t4031745# to the entrance of the Secret Passage, but the door didn't open. What the...

1.0: Ohh! Yes, this is it! This is the pass I used to use way back. What? This pass doesn't work? No way...

item.0: Hmm... you haven't found the #bpass#k yet. It's understandable. I've been looking for the pass for 90 years now, to no avail. I am sure #r#o6110301#s#k hid it somewhere safe.

0.0: I, #p2111006#, know everything that goes on with #m261000000#. If you want to know what happens in #m261000000#, I am your number one source for that, too! I even know about a secret passage that the alchemists that have engaged in barred experiments used. Hahaha... do you want to know more about the secret passage?

yes.0: Unbeknownst to most everyone, there's a #bSecret Passage#k that connects Zenumist and Alcadno. It's a secret passage that almost no one knows of. Even if you are aware of it, it's off limits. You need a #bpass#k to have access to the passage.
yes.1: But about that pass... I can't remember where I misplaced it. I don't even remember when I lost it, either. If I had that, then I would have used that passage regularly. Maybe the #r#o6110301#s#k took it...
yes.2: If you, for some reason, end up with the pass, then try using it at the entrance of the passage at either #m261010000# or #m261020200#. That should be enough to gain access to the secret passage.

no.0: You don't want to know more about it? That's strange.
